image_description: A male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on the rim of a metal bird feeder. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, orange breast, and black-and-white patterned wings. It is surrounded by green foliage in the background.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alikes like Chaffinch or Bullfinch.
To verify the structural integrity of the legs, feet, and wing attachment points which are common failure points in AI bird generation.
To check for 'melting' or halo artifacts around the complex feather edges against the busy background.
To assess overall photorealism and detect any subtle noise or texture inconsistencies.

focus_areas: Feather boundary sharpness against background foliage
Anatomical correctness of feet gripping the metal rim
Consistency of plumage patterns (white wing bars)
Beak structure and connection to head
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the bird's feet and the metal feeder. AI often struggles with the occlusion and grip mechanics here. Also, verify that the white wing bar is a distinct feature and not just a lighting artifact or smudge.
